_readme: Identity & civic content pack — UNVERIFIED SCAFFOLD.
Every rule here seeds with verificationStatus 'unverified' and every fee
carries isEstimate:true, because these processes are administered by state
and municipal bodies and differ between them. Nothing in this file is a
confirmed statement of what any authority currently requires. Someone has
to work through the verification queue against official sources before any
of it is published. See content/README.md.

documents.name: Death Certificate
documents.description: Issued by the municipal corporation or gram panchayat where the death was registered.
documents.issuingBody: Municipal Corporation / Registrar of Births & Deaths

documents.name: Hospital Birth Record
documents.description: Discharge summary or birth report from the hospital or nursing home.
documents.notes: For a home birth, the gram panchayat or a midwife's declaration is usually accepted instead.

documents.name: Medical Certificate of Cause of Death
documents.description: Form 4 or 4A, issued by the attending doctor or hospital.

documents.name: Cremation or Burial Receipt
documents.description: Receipt from the crematorium or burial ground.

documents.name: Caste Certificate
documents.description: Certifies SC, ST or OBC status for reservation benefits.

documents.name: Domicile / Residence Certificate
documents.description: Certifies that you are a permanent resident of the state.

documents.name: Legal Heir Certificate
documents.description: Names the surviving family of a deceased person. Required to transfer property, claim a pension, or settle a bank account.

documents.name: School Leaving Certificate
documents.description: Also called a transfer certificate. Widely accepted as proof of date of birth and residence.

documents.name: Salary Slip or Income Proof
documents.description: Recent payslips, Form 16, or an income tax return acknowledgement.
documents.validityWindow: Usually the last 3 months, or the most recent assessment year

documents.name: Land Record Extract
documents.description: The state's record of land holding — 7/12 extract, khatauni, patta or RTC depending on the state.
documents.validityWindow: Often required to be a recent extract rather than an old copy

documents.name: Witness Identity Proof
documents.description: Any government photo ID belonging to a witness — Aadhaar, voter ID, driving licence or passport.
documents.notes: A separate registry entry from the applicant's own ID on purpose: a rule that listed "Aadhaar" twice would collapse into one row and lose the distinction.

documents.name: Wedding Invitation Card
documents.description: Accepted by many registrars as supporting evidence of the ceremony.

documents.name: Marriage Photograph
documents.description: Photograph of the couple from the ceremony, sometimes required to show the ritual.

documents.name: Disability Medical Certificate
documents.description: Assessment issued by a government medical board stating the type and percentage of disability.
documents.notes: Often issued at the same appointment as the UDID assessment rather than beforehand.

documents.name: Newspaper Advertisement
documents.description: The published notice of a name change, in one English and one regional-language paper.
documents.notes: Keep the full original page — a cutting alone is often refused.
